from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import hashlib,json
import pandas as pd
P=Path.cwd()
R=P/'reports/research/510300_electricity_original_publication_state_v1'
if R.exists(): raise RuntimeError('新实验目录已存在，禁止覆盖')
parents=[
'reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1/全部实际原周期与用电字段.json',
'reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1/raw/official_news_catalogue.html',
'reports/research/510300_cec_national_single_month_electricity_source_qualification_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_cec_national_single_month_electricity_source_qualification_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/保存采购十变量模型.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet']
receipts=[]
for rel in parents:
 b=(P/rel).read_bytes()
 receipts.append({'path':rel,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b)})
models=json.loads((P/parents[-2]).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
cols=['date','idx','decision_time','exit_idx','valid_features']
d=pd.read_parquet(P/parents[-1],columns=cols)
current=sorted(int(x['idx']) for x in models)
members={}
union=set()
for m in models:
 i=int(m['idx'])
 mask=(d.idx>=i-504)&(d.idx<i)&(d.exit_idx<=i)&d.valid_features.fillna(False).astype(bool)
 pool=d.loc[mask,'idx'].astype(int).tolist()
 if len(pool)!=int(m['n_train']):
  raise RuntimeError('原训练成员数不一致，停止登记:'+str(i))
 members[str(i)]=pool
 union.update(pool)
required=sorted(union|set(current))
req=d[d.idx.isin(required)].copy()
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
protocol={
'study_id':'510300_ELECTRICITY_ORIGINAL_PUBLICATION_STATE_V1','experiment_id':'E41','registered_at':now,
'status':'DISTINCT_ACTUAL_PUBLICATION_FLOW_SOURCE_PHASE_REGISTERED_BEFORE_NEW_REQUESTS',
'question':'保留原通报各自实际统计区间的第二产业用电同比、区间长度和公告年龄，是否形成原评分日及同一成熟训练池完整可知的独立生产活动信息？',
'distinct_information':'E39/E40问固定统计月原单月是否存在；E41问每个历史决策日最新实际公开的区间信息，累计原同比仍标累计，单月缺失仍UNKNOWN。电量模型未曾检验，后续拟合须另登记。',
'development_disclosure':'采用公告状态表达的选择发生于已看到E39源结构和E40空索引之后；属于开发期选择，不称独立验证，也不以股票未来收益选择来源或字段。',
'fixed_stat_period_range':['2018-01','2025-12'],
'parents':receipts,
'reused_objects':['E39目录index_2.htm及2024-01~02/2024-03原HTML，哈希一致才复用'],
'initial_known_directory_urls':['https://www.nea.gov.cn/xwfb/index.htm','https://www.nea.gov.cn/xwfb/index_3.htm','https://www.nea.gov.cn/xwfb/index_4.htm'],
'allowed_directory_navigation':'只沿实际已保存的同域/xwfb/index目录锚点；不猜index_n、不抓新目录、代理或转载。',
'eligible_report':'原目录标题明确全国全社会用电量；原正文统计期在固定区间，省级、发电量、电力工业综合统计、政策解读不替代。报告是否存在未知。',
'original_row_priority':'同一公告中优先原文明确的最新单月；无单月则选原文最新累计区间。同期同类型重复版本不拼接，保存冲突并停止该冲突成员准入。',
'proposed_model_inputs':['全国第二产业原区间公布同比_pct','原统计区间月数','公告年龄_日'],
'cause_boundary':'物理活动代理不是原驱动原因、因果识别或CSI300利润；天气、工作日、效率、结构原因原文未解释就UNKNOWN。',
'historical_clock':'原网页发布日期只有日就保留日内UNKNOWN；研究保守假设当日23:59:59+08:00才可用，下一决策日生效。当前收件、URL日期、原显示发布时间分开；首版历史未认证。不能称严格first-vintage。',
'carry_state':'只沿时间使用最近已公开对象，不跨版本相减、不生成缺失单月。公告年龄大于90自然日则输入UNKNOWN；不丢原评分日或训练成员营救。',
'source_gate':'全部原1212评分日与完全相同的成熟训练成员均有非UNKNOWN三字段、原发布对象/区间/单位/时间出处完整，才允许另登记一次联合拟合；不以完整统计月数当门，不把三月有限事实称完整准入。',
'fixed_current_score_days':len(current),'fixed_required_unique_members':len(required),
'required_date_min':str(req.date.min()),'required_date_max':str(req.date.max()),
'original_rolling_sessions':504,'original_maturity_rule':'exit_idx<=current_idx; current_idx excluded','min_train':252,
'budget':{'new_linked_catalogue_gets_at_most':15,'new_original_report_gets_at_most':100,'search_queries':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'new_labels':0,'new_models':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0},
'transport':'每个原对象只GET一次；不自动跟随重定向、不关闭证书校验、不重试；实际原响应及失败保存。HTTP同域原目录链接请求前统一HTTPS并保留原链接。',
'stop':'有完整源支持再单独登记原八变量+固定三列的一次树/岭比较；缺成员则本模型NOT_RUN，来源事实保存，不挑时期或缩成员。',
'E39_E40_preserved':True,'E36_rejection_preserved':True,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False,'orders_authorized':False,'live_process':False}
R.mkdir()
def save(name,v):
 (R/name).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
save('protocol.json',protocol)
save('原评分日与完全同池成熟成员.json',{'current_indices':current,'training_members_by_current_index':members,'required_unique_indices':required,'labels_read':False,'candidate_support_is_original':True})
req.to_parquet(R/'原成员时间与标签成熟边界_未读收益值.parquet',index=False)
print(json.dumps({'登记':protocol['study_id'],'评分日':len(current),'必需独立日期':len(required),'支持起止':[protocol['required_date_min'],protocol['required_date_max']],'新网络':0,'新模型':0,'新标签':0,'源码修改':0},ensure_ascii=False))
